primitives.name: Statcast Batted Ball Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: We need barrel%, hard-hit%, EV50, LA SwSp%, exit velo avg, distance avg per player.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\omega_z': 'spin rate about vertical axis (rpm)', 'v_{exit}:': 'exit velocity at launch (mph)', 'f_{exit}(p)': 'empirical CDF of exit velocities at launch', 'Barrel\\%': 'hit events meeting Statcast barrel thresholds (dimensionless)', 'Hard-Hit\\%': 'percent of batted balls exceeding 98 mph (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Spherical projectile motion, constant air density, minimal drag nonlinearity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low spin (<1800 rpm) or high launch angle (>35°) regimes where aerodynamic models diverge.

primitives.name: Fangraphs Model Ensemble Aggregation
primitives.verbatim_quote: We need the projection numbers per player to compare against ours.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\hat{R}_i': 'projected player outcome (e.g., RCTB) for player i', 'w_m': 'weight assigned to model m (dimensionless)', '\\hat{R}_{i,m}': 'raw model prediction for player i from ensemble member m'}
primitives.assumptions: Exchangeable player outcomes, stable model performance across seasons.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High variance in model-specific predictions (e.g., ZIPS vs. STEAMER) leading to overfitting.
